g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud streaming and batch data platform in a VPC

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Apps publish click events to Pub/Sub
The streaming Dataflow job reads the subscription and enriches the events, reaching Google APIs through Private Service Connect
It writes them to Bigtable as real-time features
The Cloud Run recommendations API serves them
Partners drop files into the Cloud Storage landing bucket
Datastream replicates order changes from Cloud SQL into the raw BigQuery dataset
Cloud Composer runs the batch Dataflow load and the Dataproc Spark transform
The jobs write the curated BigQuery dataset through Private Service Connect
Looker dashboards query the curated data
Vertex AI trains the churn model on it and serves the model from an endpoint
